hypothesis: An A-owned role-separated QueryPlan can make query construction auditable and keep rejected/overridden values out of positive evidence without changing the shared request schema or retained Development quality.

category_terms.type_range: ordered unique tuple of strings; JSON diagnostic array

hard_terms.type_range: ordered unique tuple of strings; JSON diagnostic array

soft_terms.type_range: ordered unique tuple of strings; JSON diagnostic array

semantic_terms.type_range: ordered unique tuple of strings; JSON diagnostic array

residual_terms.producer: current message after exact active/excluded phrase removal
residual_terms.type_range: empty tuple or one string; JSON diagnostic array
residual_terms.rendering: positive last to preserve not-yet-extracted semantics

excluded_terms.producer: rejected and overridden constraints not currently active
excluded_terms.type_range: ordered unique tuple of strings; JSON diagnostic array
excluded_terms.lifecycle: cross-turn state summarized for current plan

rendered_query.rendering: the only value assigned to RetrievalRequest.query

fallback_to_message.producer: whether no active positive role exists

behavior_boundaries.residual_policy: Preserve residual current-message text because A11 extraction is incomplete; do not claim generic control-word removal is safe under OR+BM25.

fold_status: not rerun because every Development-160 session outcome, including first-hit turn and best rank, exactly matches the baseline; each fixed fold is a subset of these identical outcomes
keep_gate: Query roles and negative evidence are auditable; shared query schema and question policy are unchanged; Development quality is stable.
revert_gate: Revert if excluded terms re-enter rendered_query, residual removal precedes A11 evidence, the shared request shape changes, or Development session outcomes regress.
